sentences.en: As President-elect Joe Biden assembles his cabinet, his most high-profile appointments are beginning to give us a picture of the direction and ambition of his presidency.
sentences.zh: 随着当选总统乔·拜登组建内阁，他最受瞩目的任命开始让我们对他的总统任期的方向和抱负有了一个初步的了解。

sentences.en: To start, I spoke with my colleague, Gina Smileyk, about Biden's choice of a Treasury secretary in the midst of a new financial crisis.
sentences.zh: 首先，我与我的同事吉娜·斯迈利克谈到了拜登在新的金融危机中对财政部长的选择。

sentences.en: Tuesday, December 1St.
sentences.zh: 12月1日，星期二。

sentences.en: This is CNN Breaking News.
sentences.zh: 这是CNN突发新闻。

sentences.en: We're following breaking news.
sentences.zh: 我们正在关注突发新闻。

sentences.en: President-elect Joe Biden announcing historic picks for top posts in his cabinet.
sentences.zh: 当选总统乔·拜登宣布了其内阁高级职位的历史性人选。

sentences.en: NBC News has just confirmed that President-elect Joe Biden will nominate
sentences.zh: NBC新闻刚刚确认，当选总统乔·拜登将提名

sentences.en: Janet Yellen.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特·耶伦。

sentences.en: Janet Yellen, and this is the breaking news, will be the nominee for Treasury Secretary.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特·耶伦，这就是突发新闻，她将成为财政部长提名人。

sentences.en: If approved by the Senate, Yellen would be the first woman to hold the cabinet-level position of Treasury Secretary in the agency's 100-year history.
sentences.zh: 如果获得参议院批准，耶伦将成为该机构100年历史上第一位担任内阁级财政部长职位的女性。

sentences.en: But boy, will she have her work cut out for her starting on day one.
sentences.zh: 但天哪，从第一天开始，她就将面临艰巨的任务。

sentences.en: Gina, you cover economics for the Times, which is why we want to talk to you about Joe Biden's choice for Treasury Secretary, which is Janet Yellen.
sentences.zh: 吉娜，你为《时报》报道经济新闻，这就是为什么我们要和你谈谈乔·拜登对财政部长的选择，也就是珍妮特·耶伦。

sentences.en: And I want to start by asking you how important you think the job of Treasury Secretary is going to be in this incoming presidential
sentences.zh: 我想先问问你，考虑到她即将面临的局面，你认为财政部长这个职位在即将上任的总统

sentences.en: administration, given the situation that she will be walking into.
sentences.zh: 政府中会有多重要？

sentences.en: I think it's honestly hard to overstate how important this job is going to be.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我认为怎么强调这个职位的重要性都不为过。

sentences.en: You know, the Treasury Secretary is the person who liaises with Congress over fiscal spending packages.
sentences.zh: 你知道，财政部长是负责与国会就财政支出方案进行联络的人。

sentences.en: And so I think her role in negotiating with what looks quite possibly like a Republican Senate is going to
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，她在与看起来很可能是共和党控制的参议院进行谈判时，对于塑造下一份政府支出方案的规模和范围将

sentences.en: be really crucial in shaping both the size and the scope of the next government spending package.
sentences.zh: 起到至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: And the ongoing relief to this coronavirus pandemic.
sentences.zh: 以及针对这场新冠疫情的持续救助。

sentences.en: And then I think she's also going to be a really important voice in talking about what kind of reforms need to be made coming out of this crisis.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，在谈论走出这场危机需要进行什么样的改革时，她也将是一个非常重要的声音。

sentences.en: But at that moment, we're going to have to talk about how financial regulation responds and how government spending packages should be shaped going forward.
sentences.zh: 但在那一刻，我们将不得不讨论金融监管应如何应对，以及未来的政府支出方案应如何制定。

sentences.en: And I think on all of those issues,
sentences.zh: 我认为在所有这些问题上，

sentences.en: Janet Yellen is going to really be the voice at the forefront.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特·耶伦都将真正成为站在最前沿的发声者。

sentences.en: So when it comes to the economy, she will be the single most important person in the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 所以当谈到经济时，她将是拜登政府中唯一最重要的人。

sentences.en: I would say yes.
sentences.zh: 我会说是的。

sentences.en: From a political standpoint, she will be the most important person to sort of form the first line of defense for the economy against the ongoing effects of this pandemic recession.
sentences.zh: 从政治角度来看，她将是为经济构筑第一道防线，以抵御这场疫情衰退持续影响的最重要人物。

sentences.en: So what should we know about Janet Yellen and how she arrives on Biden's radar?
sentences.zh: 那么关于珍妮特·耶伦，我们应该了解些什么？她是如何进入拜登视野的？

sentences.en: Where does that story start?
sentences.zh: 这个故事是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: Janet Yellen was kind of a wonk from birth.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特·耶伦天生就是个书呆子。

sentences.en: So I think you kind of have to go back to sort of her roots to talk about how that story started.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为你必须回到她的根源，才能谈论这个故事是如何开始的。

sentences.en: You know, she's born in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, so middle class neighborhood in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她出生在布鲁克林的贝岭，那是布鲁克林的一个中产阶级社区。

sentences.en: She is the child of a teacher who stayed home to raise her and a doctor.
sentences.zh: 她是家里的一名教师（为了抚养她而留在家中）和一名医生的孩子。

sentences.en: She was class valedictorian editor of her school newspaper.
sentences.zh: 她是班级的毕业生代表，也是校报编辑。

sentences.en: She once quite famously interviewed herself for the school newspaper because the newspaper editor traditionally interviewed the valedictorian.
sentences.zh: 她曾经非常出名地采访了自己，因为校报编辑传统上要采访毕业生代表。

sentences.en: Oh, geez.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Yeah, she was a nerd.
sentences.zh: 是的，她是个书呆子。

sentences.en: She had a rock collection, which came out in that article.
sentences.zh: 她有一个岩石收藏，这在那篇文章中被提到了。

sentences.en: So she was a nerd from the start.
sentences.zh: 所以她从一开始就是个书呆子。

sentences.en: She went to Brown University.
sentences.zh: 她去了布朗大学。

sentences.en: I always liked math and science, and I went off to college with the thought I might be a math major.
sentences.zh: 我一直喜欢数学和科学，我上大学时以为自己可能会主修数学。

sentences.en: And she knew she wanted to study something mathy because she liked math.
sentences.zh: 她知道自己想学一些数学相关的东西，因为她喜欢数学。

sentences.en: But I was fortunate to take economics during my first year at Brown, and that was love at first sight, and I never looked back.
sentences.zh: 但幸运的是，我在布朗大学的第一年选修了经济学，那是一见钟情，从此我就再也没有回头。

sentences.en: But when she took economics, she just fell in love.
sentences.zh: 但当她接触到经济学时，她就爱上了它。

sentences.en: You know, she realized that it had this huge potential to shape the public conversation and to have an impact on ordinary people's lives, and that was what she wanted.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她意识到经济学具有塑造公共对话和影响普通人生活的巨大潜力，而这正是她想要的。

sentences.en: It was really about things that are fundamental to human welfare.
sentences.zh: 这确实关乎人类福祉的基本要素。

sentences.en: Opportunity, the ability to support one's family and to achieve one's goals, to have a secure retirement, to see one's children advance and do well.
sentences.zh: 机会，养家糊口和实现目标的能力，拥有安全的退休生活，看到自己的孩子进步并取得成就。

sentences.en: She was never after getting some sort of Wall Street job with an economics degree.
sentences.zh: 她从来没有想过要用经济学学位去华尔街找工作。

sentences.en: She was really interested in having some bearing on how the world played out for real people.
sentences.zh: 她真正感兴趣的是对现实世界的发展产生某种影响。

sentences.en: I think one thing that is important to know about Janet Yellen is she ascribes to this ideology, which is called Keynesian
sentences.zh: 我认为了解珍妮特·耶伦的一点很重要，那就是她信奉一种被称为凯恩斯主义的意识形态，

sentences.en: Economics.
sentences.zh: 即凯恩斯经济学。

sentences.en: And the gist of that is just that any time the economy is going badly and things are not playing out as you would want, there is some government role in righting the ship.
sentences.zh: 其要点在于，每当经济运行不佳、事情没有按照你希望的方向发展时，政府在纠正航向方面就发挥着作用。

sentences.en: And we shouldn't allow a prolonged period of very high unemployment.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该允许长期的高失业率存在。

sentences.en: Free markets are good news.
sentences.zh: 自由市场是好消息。

sentences.en: They generally are beneficial, but they don't work perfectly.
sentences.zh: 它们通常是有益的，但它们并不完美。

sentences.en: They have imperfections, and sometimes they break down.
sentences.zh: 它们有缺陷，有时会崩溃。

sentences.en: And when that happens, the government needs to step in and fix the problem.
sentences.zh: 当这种情况发生时，政府需要介入并解决问题。

sentences.en: And I guess that tied in with my own upbringing.
sentences.zh: 我想这与我自己的成长经历有关。

sentences.en: My parents had grown up.
sentences.zh: 我的父母是在大萧条时期长大的大学生，这影响了他们的生活。

sentences.en: They were college students during the Great Depression, and it had influenced their lives.
sentences.zh: 所以她非常属于那种积极的、干预主义的经济学流派。

sentences.en: And so she is very much of that sort of activist, interventionist vein of economics.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我在成长过程中经常听到如果有人失业，对家庭生活意味着什么。

sentences.en: You know, I heard very often when I was growing up about what it meant to family life if someone lost a job.
sentences.zh: 这种哲学确实影响了她整个职业生涯中所从事的每一份工作。

sentences.en: And that philosophy really went on to influence every job she took throughout her entire career.
sentences.zh: 那么那些工作是什么？

sentences.en: And what were those jobs?
sentences.zh: 所以她在许多关键的经济政策岗位上工作过，既是作为一名学者，

sentences.en: So she worked in a number of key economic policy positions, both, you know, as an academic.
sentences.zh: 然后她在联邦储备银行工作，那是国家的中央银行。

sentences.en: Then she was at the Federal Reserve Bank, which is the nation central bank.
sentences.zh: 然后她搬到了克林顿白宫，担任高级经济顾问。

sentences.en: Then she moved to the Clinton
sentences.zh: 所以她担任了总统首席顾问的角色。

sentences.en: White House as a top economic advisor.
sentences.zh: 最终她在2000年代进入了旧金山联邦储备银行。

sentences.en: So she was in a really chief advisor role to the president.
sentences.zh: 我认为她在旧金山任职期间有趣的是，她负责监控整个西海岸的经济。

sentences.en: And she ultimately lands in the 2000s at the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 她与当地人交谈，并注意到房地产市场正在发生一些奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: And I think what's interesting about her time in San Francisco is that she is in charge in that role of kind of keeping tabs on the entire West Coast economy.
sentences.zh: 房价和开发价格确实与经济学家所说的基本面脱节了，也就是基于经济状况应该合理的水平。

sentences.en: And she is talking to people on the ground and noticing that something weird is happening with the housing market.
sentences.zh: 她开始担心那里正在形成金融泡沫。

sentences.en: House prices and development prices are really getting out of line with, you know, what economists call fundamentals, what should be justified based on economic conditions.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这个职位上，她确实成为了早期预警经济可能出现问题的人之一。

sentences.en: And she's sort of getting worried that a financial bubble is forming out there.
sentences.zh: 事实证明她是正确的。

sentences.en: And so in this role, she really sort of served as an early person saying that there might be something going wrong in the economy.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，她发现得不够早，美联储无法真正采取任何行动。

sentences.en: And she turns out to be right.
sentences.zh: 但她是正确的。

sentences.en: She doesn't spot it early enough for the Fed to really do anything about it, unfortunately.
sentences.zh: 房地产泡沫破裂了。

sentences.en: But she is right.
sentences.zh: 出现了一场巨大的衰退，这是自大萧条以来最严重的衰退，导致数百万人失业。

sentences.en: The housing bubble bursts.
sentences.zh: 失业率基本上达到了10%。

sentences.en: There is a huge recession, the worst recession since the Great Depression, throws millions of people out of work.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这带来了非常非常可怕的后果。

sentences.en: Unemployment hits basically 10 percent.
sentences.zh: 但我认为她注意到这一点的先见之明，为她赢得了民主党政策制定者和整个领域经济学家的赞誉。

sentences.en: You know, terrible, terrible fallout from this.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: But I think her prescience in noticing it is something that earned her a lot of kudos, both with
sentences.zh: 在过去的五年里，美国奋力从自大萧条以来最严重的衰退中恢复过来。

sentences.en: Democratic policymakers and with economists throughout the field.
sentences.zh: 所以快进到2013年，劳动力市场看起来仍然很糟糕。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 经济增长依然缓慢。

sentences.en: Over the past five years, America has fought its way back from the worst recession since the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 这让每个人都感到惊讶，因为此时距离衰退在技术上已经过去了四年。

sentences.en: So then you fast forward to 2013 and the labor market is still looking rough.
sentences.zh: 所以现在情况应该有所好转了。

sentences.en: The economy is still growing slowly.
sentences.zh: 但什么都没有发生。

sentences.en: And this is surprising to everyone because at this point, we're technically four years after the recession.
sentences.zh: 一切仍然非常痛苦。

sentences.en: So things should be picking up by now.
sentences.zh: 我认为每个人都明白，我们在重建中产阶级方面还有很多工作要做。

sentences.en: But nothing is.
sentences.zh: 带领我们度过危机初期阶段的美联储主席本·伯南克已经宣布他将卸任。

sentences.en: Everything is very painful still.
sentences.zh: 所以他的职位将空缺。

sentences.en: I think everybody understands we've still got a lot of work to do to rebuild the middle class.
sentences.zh: 今天，我只想花一点时间向本的非凡服务表示敬意。

sentences.en: And Ben Bernanke, the Fed chair who got us through the initial phases of the crisis, has announced that he's stepping down.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: So his job is going to be open.
sentences.zh: 但我也想宣布我下一任美联储主席的人选。

sentences.en: Today, I just want to take a minute to pay tribute to Ben for his extraordinary service.
sentences.zh: 面对填补当时全球经济中可以说最重要的职位，

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 这是任何总统都能做出的最重要的任命之一。

sentences.en: But I also want to announce my choice for the next chair of the Federal Reserve.
sentences.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马决定他将提名

sentences.en: Faced with filling what is arguably the most important job in the global economy at that moment.
sentences.zh: 国家最重要的经济学家和政策制定者之一，现任副主席珍妮特·耶伦。

sentences.en: One of the most important appointments that any president can make.
sentences.zh: 在做出这一决定时，他引用了她在房地产市场的记录。

sentences.en: Barack Obama decides that he is going to nominate.
sentences.zh: 她很早就对房地产泡沫发出了警报。

sentences.en: One of the nation's foremost economists and policymakers, current vice chairman, Jenny Yellen.
sentences.zh: 她拥有深厚的经济学背景。

sentences.en: And making that decision, he cites her record with the housing market.
sentences.zh: 她没有水晶球，但她确实敏锐地理解市场和经济是如何运作的。

sentences.en: She sounded the alarm early about the housing bubble.
sentences.zh: 并真正表达了信心，认为她是带领我们度过下一个时期的合适人选。

sentences.en: Her strong background in economics.
sentences.zh: 我绝对相信她将成为一位杰出的美联储主席。

sentences.en: She doesn't have a crystal ball, but what she does have is a keen understanding about how markets and the economy work.
sentences.zh: 显然，国会也同意了，因为她被确认担任该职位，并将作为美联储有史以来第一位女性主席前往美联储。

sentences.en: And really voices confidence that she's the right person to lead us through this next period.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，总统先生。

sentences.en: I'm absolutely confident that she will be an exceptional chair of the
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸，也对你给予我的信任感到谦卑。

sentences.en: Federal Reserve.
sentences.zh: 我承诺将竭尽全力保持这份信任。那么，我们如何开始看到她的凯恩斯主义经济哲学以及她在美联储多年的经验，开始

sentences.en: And evidently, Congress agrees because she is confirmed to the role and she is headed to the Fed as its first ever female chairwoman.
sentences.zh: 转化为美国经济在这个极其微妙时刻的政策？

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I'm honored and humbled by the faith that you've placed in me.
sentences.zh: 所以她在2014年进入了这个经济体，当时经济疲软但正在缓慢复苏。

sentences.en: I pledge to do my utmost to keep that truSt. And so how do we start to see her Keynesian economic philosophy and all her years of experience throughout the Fed start to
sentences.zh: 随着经济缓慢复苏，经济学家开始担心美联储，为了刺激需求，美联储将利率维持在非常低的水平，这是

sentences.en: turn into policy at this really delicate moment in the American economy?
sentences.zh: 他们实现这一目标的主要工具，需要行动起来了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们需要开始提高利率以稍微放缓经济。

sentences.en: So she comes in to this economy in 2014 that is weak but is slowly healing.
sentences.zh: 但珍妮特·耶伦环顾四周，她看到的经济仍然没有足够快地吸引工人。

sentences.en: And as it slowly heals, economists are starting to get worried that the Fed, which has interest rates at very low levels in order to stimulate demand, that's
sentences.zh: 她觉得这个劳动力市场还有更多的增长空间。

sentences.en: their primary tool for doing that, needs to get on the ball.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到她为加息制定了一条非常耐心的前进道路。

sentences.en: You know, they need to start hiking those interest rates to slow things down a little bit.
sentences.zh: 她没有迅速行动。

sentences.en: But Janet Yellen looks around and she sees an economy that still isn't pulling workers in fast enough.
sentences.zh: 她让经济继续复苏。

sentences.zh: 这就是联邦政府每周给失业人员的600美元。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This was the $600 a week to people who lost their job from the federal government.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们还不知道那会是什么样子的确切轮廓，但我认为我们当然可以预期她会采取那种支持

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 家庭、支持家庭的角色，她经常扮演这个角色，你知道，作为一个外部倡导者。

sentences.en: And so I don't think we know exactly the contours of what that'll look like yet, but I think we can certainly expect that she's going to take sort of that support for
sentences.zh: 我认为她会把这一点带到财政部。

sentences.en: households, support for families role that she has often played, you know, as an outside advocate.

sentences.en: I think she'll bring that to the Treasury.
sentences.zh: 如果本届国会仍然由共和党控制，我想知道你认为耶伦在实际通过你刚才描述的这些干预主义政策方面能有多成功。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果本届国会仍然由共和党控制，她将很难通过州和地方的支持。

sentences.en: And if this Congress remains Republican, I wonder how successful you think Yellen could be in actually getting these interventionist policies that you just described passed.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为她对此已经非常清楚了。

sentences.en: I think if this Congress remains Republican, she is going to really struggle to get state and local supports through.
sentences.zh: 在她看来，毫无疑问这是必要的，但我认为这在共和党人那里很难推销。

sentences.en: You know, that is something that I think she's been very clear.
sentences.zh: 我认为你可能会在失业保险等方面看到更大的成功。

sentences.en: There's no question in her mind that that is needed, but I think it's just very hard to sell with the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 这有一个非常简单的原因，那就是许多许多不同国会议员的选民，

sentences.en: I think that you might see greater success in things like unemployment insurance.
sentences.zh: 现在都在受苦，需要失业保险福利。

sentences.en: And there's a really simple reason for that, which is that many, many people who are constituents to many,
sentences.zh: 所以有一些更多的两党支持，你知道，真正帮助你的基础。

sentences.en: many different Congress members are suffering right now and need unemployment insurance benefits.
sentences.zh: 所以她在这些方面可能会比在州和地方问题上更有运气。

sentences.en: And so there is some more bipartisan support to, you know, really help your base out.
sentences.zh: 所以像当选总统拜登一样，珍妮特·耶伦在佐治亚州的那两场参议院竞选以及民主党赢得这些席位上押注了很多。

sentences.en: And so she might have better luck along those dimensions than she will with the state and local stuff.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So like president-elect Biden, Janet Yellen has a lot riding on those two Senate races in Georgia and the Democrats winning those seats.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，还有其他事情她可以在没有参议院的情况下做。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些地方她可以作为财政部长单方面产生影响。

sentences.en: That said, there are other things she can do without the Senate.
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: You know, there are places she can have an impact just unilaterally as treasury secretary.
sentences.zh: 她将在谈判贸易协议中处于核心地位。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 而且我认为重要的是，她在这里的观点与特朗普政府形成了鲜明的对比，你知道，特朗普

sentences.en: She will be central to negotiating trade deals.
sentences.zh: 政府通常认为贸易对美国来说是一笔糟糕的交易，并真正试图重写规则手册。

sentences.en: And I think it's important that her outlook here contrasts really sharply with the Trump administrations, you know, where the Trump
sentences.zh: 我认为珍妮特·耶伦看待贸易时，认为它确实帮助经济

sentences.en: administration saw trade as generally a bad deal for America and really tried to rewrite the rulebook.
sentences.zh: 增长得更快，并且有无数的好处，当你在试图重塑系统时，这些好处需要被考虑在内。

sentences.en: I think Janet Yellen looks at trade and sees it as something that has really helped the economy to
sentences.zh: 她承认存在缺陷。

sentences.en: grow faster and had just myriad benefits that need to be taken into account when you're trying to rework the system.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我们会看到回归到20世纪90年代和80年代那种对自由贸易的全面拥抱，且规则手册有限。

sentences.en: She recognizes that there are flaws.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们将看到的是一种非常审慎的贸易方法，强调全球合作，强调在世界贸易组织等国际机构的领导地位，

sentences.en: I don't think that we're going to see a return to sort of the 1990s and the 1980s and the sort of full-fledged embrace of free trade with limited rulebook.
sentences.zh: 但也试图确保有安全措施，以确保美国收入阶层底层的工人们不会受到这些政策的伤害。

sentences.en: I think what we're going to see is a very sort of measured approach to trade that emphasizes global cooperation, emphasizes leadership at international bodies like the World Trade
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Organization, but also tries to make sure that there are safeties in place to make sure that workers
sentences.zh: 所以在珍妮特·耶伦看来，美国可以积极参与全球贸易，而不会——借用唐纳德·特朗普的一个词——坑害美国工人。

sentences.en: at the sort of bottom of the income spectrum here in America don't get hurt by these policies.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 所以最后，吉娜，你开始时说，很难夸大耶伦作为财政部长的重要性，

sentences.en: So in Janet Yellen's view, the United States can actively participate in global trade without it, to borrow a Donald Trump word, screwing American workers.
sentences.zh: 因为这场金融危机的严重性以及

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 她所拥有的经验。

sentences.en: So finally, Gina, you started by saying that it would be hard to overstate what Yellen's importance
sentences.zh: 这确实是她将要面对的挑战。

sentences.en: would be as Treasury Secretary because of the significance of this financial crisis and the
sentences.zh: 这确实是她将要面对的挑战。

sentences.en: responsibility that she will have for trying to solve it, but also, you said, because of the regulations that might follow when we eventually emerge from the crisis.
sentences.zh: 她将承担起试图解决问题的责任，但正如你所说，也是因为我们最终走出危机后可能会随之而来的监管措施。

sentences.en: What did you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: You know, I think that it's going to be really interesting to watch her inaction after the
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得观察她在疫情之后会有什么作为会非常有趣，

sentences.en: pandemic because this is really the moment that her career and her experience has been building towards.
sentences.zh: 因为这确实是她职业生涯和经验积累所指向的时刻。

sentences.en: You know, she has very much spent her time in economic policy kind of trying to carve out a
sentences.zh: 你知道，她一直以来在经济政策方面所花费的时间，某种程度上是在试图开辟一个

sentences.en: space where she puts training wheels on capitalism, you know, makes it safer for households and for businesses.
sentences.zh: 空间，为资本主义装上辅助轮，你知道，让它对家庭和企业来说更安全。

sentences.en: And I think Treasury Secretary is going to be a really interesting perch from which she can sort of further those goals.
sentences.zh: 我认为财政部长这个职位将是一个非常有趣的平台，她可以借此进一步推动这些目标。

sentences.en: And so I think you could see her be activist in kind of pushing for common sense, middle-of-the-road reforms that nevertheless leave the system a little bit more guarded.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为你可以看到她会积极推动那些常识性的、中庸的改革，但这些改革会让体系得到更好的保护。

sentences.en: Things like stabilizers that kick in anytime the economy takes a turn for the worse, that don't necessarily require Congress to vote to pass a package.
sentences.zh: 比如在经济恶化时自动启动的稳定器，这些措施不一定需要国会投票通过法案。

sentences.en: So for example, if unemployment shoots up, maybe unemployment insurance immediately becomes more generous.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果失业率飙升，也许失业保险会立即变得更加慷慨。

sentences.en: And that's the kind of thing that we've seen her talk about, the fact that that could be useful.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们看到她谈论过的那种事情，即这些措施可能会很有用。

sentences.en: And I think you could see her really have a bully pulpit to push for policies like that.
sentences.zh: 我认为你可以看到她确实拥有一个强大的话语权平台来推动这类政策。

sentences.en: She can't pass them, but she can certainly advocate for them as Treasury Secretary.
sentences.zh: 她无法直接通过这些政策，但作为财政部长，她当然可以倡导它们。

sentences.en: And I think at the end of the day, what we're just going to see is sort of this realization of her career-long economic philosophy, which is just that, you know, capitalism
sentences.zh: 我认为归根结底，我们将看到的是她职业生涯一贯的经济哲学的实现，那就是，你知道，资本主义

sentences.en: works, markets work, but sometimes the government needs to step in and make sure that they are
sentences.zh: 是有效的，市场是有效的，但有时政府需要介入，确保它们

sentences.en: fostering an equal chance for everybody and a real sort of, you know, positive economy that can lift all boats.
sentences.zh: 在为每个人创造平等机会，并营造一种真正积极的、能让所有人受益的经济环境。

sentences.en: And I think this is kind of her moment to make sure that that comes true.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是她实现这一目标的时刻。

sentences.en: Well, Gina, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，吉娜，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: On Monday, President Trump's attempt to deny Joe Biden his victory hit its latest roadblock
sentences.zh: 周一，特朗普总统试图否认乔·拜登胜选的努力遭遇了最新的阻碍，

sentences.en: when officials in Wisconsin and Arizona certified Biden's victory, despite pressure from the president not to do so.
sentences.zh: 威斯康星州和亚利桑那州的官员认证了拜登的胜利，尽管总统施压要求他们不要这样做。

sentences.en: At the same time, the president was again rebuffed in Georgia, which has also certified Biden as the winner.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，总统在佐治亚州再次受挫，该州也已认证拜登为获胜者。

sentences.zh: 布莱恩·肯普，拒绝了特朗普在推特上提出的要求，即调查毫无根据的

sentences.en: of voter fraud and, in the case of the governor, that he illegally interfere in the election process on Trump's behalf.
sentences.zh: 选民欺诈指控，对于州长而言，还拒绝了特朗普要求他代表其非法干预选举程序的要求。

sentences.en: There are those who are exploiting the emotions of many Trump supporters with fantastic claims,

sentences.zh: 然后呢？

sentences.zh: 在对疫情发出严厉警告时，加州州长加文·纽森表示，该州的

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。
